principle_1_policy_travels_with_the_requ.name: Routing policy is request data, not server state
principle_1_policy_travels_with_the_requ.summary: The whole target tree, retry budget, timeout and guardrail set arrive in a header and are validated per request; the process keeps nothing about routing between requests, so any node can serve any caller's policy.
principle_1_policy_travels_with_the_requ.tradeoff: Perfect horizontal scalability and zero config-deploy latency, paid for with total amnesia: no health, no learning and no fairness is even expressible.

principle_2_one_recursion_for_all_strate.name: Every strategy is a node in one recursive walk
principle_2_one_recursion_for_all_strate.summary: Ordered failover, weighted selection, predicate routing and the single-target case are branches of one switch inside a function that calls itself with the child target and a merged inherited config, so strategies nest arbitrarily and leaf nodes are the only place a provider is actually called.
principle_2_one_recursion_for_all_strate.tradeoff: Composability for free, but each strategy is deliberately shallow: the weighted group has no failover of its own, and giving it one would mean re-entering the same recursion from a different place.

principle_3_distinguish_their_failure_fr.name: Mark your own exceptions so the retry machinery stops
principle_3_distinguish_their_failure_fr.summary: Any exception raised inside the gateway becomes a response carrying an internal marker, and the failover loop treats that marker as an unconditional stop, so an internal bug is never laundered into several upstream calls.
principle_3_distinguish_their_failure_fr.tradeoff: Needs a reserved out-of-band channel on the response and discipline about which errors get the marker; get it wrong and a real provider failure stops the chain too.

principle_4_budgets_are_per_request_and_.name: Bound the pathological case with a constant, not a promise
principle_4_budgets_are_per_request_and_.summary: Politeness toward a provider's advertised wait is capped by a hard 60 s per-request budget that is decremented as waits are honoured, and once the remaining budget cannot cover the next wait the retry loop is cut dead rather than sleeping.
principle_4_budgets_are_per_request_and_.tradeoff: Guarantees a request cannot be parked indefinitely by a hostile advertised wait, but converts a legitimately long back-off into an immediate failure the caller must handle.

principle_5_report_the_node_not_the_reas.name: Name the decision by its address in the config
principle_5_report_the_node_not_the_reas.summary: Instead of an explanation object, the response carries the path of the config node that served it, built incrementally as the recursion descends, plus an attempt counter and cache status.
principle_5_report_the_node_not_the_reas.tradeoff: Cheap, stable and exactly aligned with what the operator wrote; it cannot explain a probabilistic choice, so a weighted draw is observable but neither reproducible nor auditable.

principle_6_leave_seams_for_the_commerci.name: Ship the hook, not the policy
principle_6_leave_seams_for_the_commerci.summary: Health quarantine, per-caller budgets and price data are read out of the request context as optional injected functions and flags; when absent the code paths degrade to no-ops without branching the router.
principle_6_leave_seams_for_the_commerci.tradeoff: Keeps the open core small and one router implementation serves both products, but an unwary reader sees quarantine and budget code and concludes the behaviour exists when it does not.
